desktop.description: Round 3 Thread 1: desktop, window management, responsive layout and launch UX; no application internals

disk.description: Round 3 Thread 2: virtual filesystem, backup, removable media, SwarmWire transfer state and installation; no Postbox content or Norn simulation

apps.description: Round 3 Thread 3: independent non-Norn games, music studio, Audacity; excludes story Bloodline and Sprite Studio

network.description: Round 3 Thread 4: fictional LatchNet websites, browser content, Postbox mail UI and hidden clues; no virtual disk or SwarmWire behavior

sprite.description: Round 3 Thread 5: standalone Sprite Studio drawing, animation, formats and offline Flipnote compatibility

integrator.description: Latch-only release coordinator: packaging, interfaces, tests, merge and source integration

merge_policy: Workers submit only owned UTF-8 paths; Norn simulation/code is maintained solely by Norn World Lab integrator. Latch integrator alone imports a separately validated Norn release; no worker modifies Norn or the Bloodline story. One baseline, no cross-thread file edits.
